method: CatBoost 1.2.10; three representations; no target data or metadata features
representations: 112 physical features + all 150 standardized sequential values
checkpoint_selection: source validation macro F1; all 1200 iterations run
promotion: Screening alone cannot promote. Require every seed42/43/44 of a hybrid retaining RF and temporal branches to improve matched-anchor macro F1 by >=.01, no recall loss >.03, no increase in fault-normal or accepted false-normal. Target never used for selection.
versions: Existing V0/V1/V2 parents remain distinct; any successful boost is a same-architecture improvement stage.
